items.evidence: versions/26.1/tools/test_model_baking_parity.py:client_libraries() (lines 58-68) builds the client classpath from the manifest only and does not append tools/jsr305-3.0.2.jar. The 1.21.7 Batch 0 fix for the identical defect (d7a14e91) is NOT in the 26.1 tree (same gap as 26.2). Without jsr305, javac crashes (rc=4, CompletionFailure: class file for javax.annotation.Nullable not found) when compiling an oracle that completes a Nullable-referencing symbol — a latent crash across the oracle_harness drivers. The measurement adds jsr305 itself, so the numbers above are unaffected. Fix direction: append jsr305 in client_libraries() — one point, fixes all users. Not fixed in this batch (measurement + triage only).

systemic_note: Same root cause as the pilot's G1/G3/G5/G6, two versions further back: the 26.1 tree carries 26.3 API forms (packages, constructors, abstract methods, holder classes) for things that do not exist in vanilla 26.1, and every such reference fails loudly at javac time in the oracles (unlike the port code, where the same pattern silently degrades). The new 26.1-specific group is the EntityTypes holder move (O5, 31 files) — 26.1 predates it, so every EntityTypes.X reference fails; the translation back to EntityType.X is mechanical and javap-verified. Two mechanical groups (LocalPlayer ctor, 20 files with 7 single-cause; Level.fuelValues(), 4 files) rescue files with two signature translations. The densityfunction (O4, 17 files) and renderpearl/material.rule (O6) groups are the genuinely hard ones: 26.3-only APIs with no 26.1 equivalent to translate to import-by-import. Compiling is not running (O8) — the runtime layer is unmeasured and each oracle needs an end-to-end driver run.
